newsitem.title: USA: IBM unveils new ThinkPad notebook computer.
newsitem.headline: IBM unveils new ThinkPad notebook computer.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp said Tuesday it unveiled its new ThinkPad 380 notebook computer series.
The "all-in-one" design integrates a hard drive, a floppy drive and a CD-ROM in one unit with a 12.1-inch screen and Pentium microprocessor.
The company said estimated reseller prices for the ThinkPad 380 series would start at $2,199 depending on model and configuration.

All ThinkPad 380 series models come standard with 16 megabytes (MB) of random access memory (RAM), expandable to 80MB. The series also features the 150MHz Intel Corp Pentium processor, available with and without MMX multimedia technology and includes 256 kilobytes (KB) of L2 cache.

The company said the new ThinkPads, geared toward the general business market as well as consumers, are available through computer reseller channels, while the ThinkPad 385D is available in retail stores.
